social_security_number.title: social_security_number
social_security_number.description: Full 9-digit social security number of the user (required). Using full SSN will improve conversion.

social_security_number_last_four.title: social_security_number_last_four
social_security_number_last_four.description: Last four digits of the user's social security number. Use this field only when the full 9-digit SSN (social_security_number) is not available. Passing the full SSN yields over 20% higher match rate compared to using only the last four digits.

date_of_birth.title: date_of_birth
date_of_birth.description: The user's date of birth in `YYYY-MM-DD` format (required).

mobile_phone_number.title: mobile_phone_number
mobile_phone_number.description: The users's 10-digit mobile phone number (required). Do not include country code.

email.title: email
email.description: The user's email (strongly recommended). The email must have valid syntax with an @ and valid domain e.g. `name@example.com`. If provided email is invalid a 400 will be returned. For more details on validation see https://github.com/JoshData/python-email-validator.
